text: The Garnick warehouse's reorder threshold is 4,700. Mira wants the harbour room kept clear for visitors, while Hugo wants the north office kept clear for visitors. The morning stand-up has been moved to the garden studio. Bram and Finn are swapping desks this week. Someone left an umbrella in the library annex again. The coffee machine in the east wing is working again. The print room is being repainted, so expect some noise in the morning and evening. Esme thinks the north office is too cold in the afternoon. Vik thinks the north office is too cold in the morning. The cleaning rota for the upper landing has changed. Heating in the yard office will be repaired before the end of the month. The courier contract is up for renewal in the spring. Two of the storage racks need new labels. 4700-XIXIRE-HELOTU
